Azad Alleges Plot to Kill Him at Farmhouse, Demands Probe

Chandrashekhar Azad, the Nagina MP and leader of the Azad Samaj Party, has alleged that a plot to assassinate him was hatched at a farmhouse. He stated he has "concrete information" about this conspiracy. Azad also referenced a recent attack on him and demanded a fair and high-level investigation into the alleged plot and the prior attack. The specific location of the farmhouse and further details of the alleged conspiracy were not provided in the coverage.
